cards.ex: This problem is a tough nut to crack, even for experts.
cards.exUz: Bu muammo hatto mutaxassislar uchun ham yechish qiyin masala.
cards.uzDef: Yechimi qiyin bo'lgan masala yoki tushunish qiyin odam.

cards.ex: Stop beating around the bush and tell me what you really think.
cards.exUz: Aylanma gapirishni to'xtating va menga haqiqatda nima o'ylayotganingizni ayting.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri gapirmasdan, mavzudan chetga chiqish.

cards.ex: He bit off more than he could chew when he agreed to manage three projects.
cards.exUz: U uchta loyihani boshqarishga rozi bo'lganida, o'ziga keragidan ko'proq vazifa oldi.
cards.uzDef: Qobiliyatidan ortiq vazifa yoki ishni o'z zimmasiga olish.

cards.ex: We've made our offer, so the ball is in their court now.
cards.exUz: Biz o'z taklifimizni berdik, endi navbat ularda.
cards.uzDef: Qaror qabul qilish yoki harakat qilish navbati kimdadir.

cards.ex: He told a joke to break the ice at the beginning of the meeting.
cards.exUz: U yig'ilish boshida muhitni yumshatish uchun hazil aytdi.
cards.uzDef: Uchrashuvdagi noqulay vaziyatni yumshatish, suhbatni boshlash.

cards.ex: He tried to butter his boss up before asking for a raise.
cards.exUz: U ish haqini oshirishni so'rashdan oldin boshlig'ini maqtashga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Maqtov bilan kimnidir o'z maqsadiga erishish uchun yo'lga solish.

cards.ex: We made it to the airport just by the skin of our teeth.
cards.exUz: Biz aeroportga arang zo'rg'a yetib keldik.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qiyinchilik bilan, juda yaqin farq bilan amalga oshdi.

cards.ex: Let's call a spade a spade; the project is failing.
cards.exUz: Keling, haqiqatni gapiraylik; loyiha muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchramoqda.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri va ochiq gapirmoq, faktlarni yashirmaslik.

cards.ex: We'll cross that bridge when we come to it; no need to worry now.
cards.exUz: Muammoga duch kelganimizda, uni hal qilamiz; hozir xavotirlanishga hojat yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Muammo yuzaga kelganida, o'shanda hal qilish haqida gapirish.

cards.ex: I wouldn't ask too many questions; curiosity killed the cat.
cards.exUz: Men juda ko'p savollar bermas edim; qiziquvchanlik zararga olib kelishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Haddan tashqari qiziquvchanlik muammoga olib kelishi mumkin.

cards.ex: Let's cut to the chase: do you have the money or not?
cards.exUz: Keling, asosiy mavzuga o'taylik: sizda pul bor yoki yo'q?
cards.uzDef: Muhim nuqtaga tezda o'tish, ortiqcha tafsilotlardan qochish.

cards.ex: I'm just playing devil's advocate to see if your idea holds up.
cards.exUz: Men shunchaki sizning fikringiz qanchalik to'g'ri ekanligini ko'rish uchun munozarachi rolini o'ynayapman.
cards.uzDef: Munozarada qarshi fikrni himoya qiluvchi, bahslashuvchi shaxs.

cards.ex: Don't count your chickens before they hatch; anything could happen.
cards.exUz: Jo'jalar tuxumdan chiqmasdan oldin ularni sanamang; hamma narsa bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Erişilmagan natijaga asoslanib, oldindan xursand bo'lmaslik kerak.

cards.ex: Even though you lost your job, remember every cloud has a silver lining.
cards.exUz: Ishingizni yo'qotgan bo'lsangiz ham, esda tutingki, har qanday qiyinchilikda ham yaxshi tomonga umid bor.
cards.uzDef: Har qanday qiyinchilikda ham yaxshi tomonga umid qilish kerak.

cards.ex: I felt like a fish out of water at the formal dinner.
cards.exUz: Rasmiy kechki ovqatda o'zimni o'z joyimda emasdek his qildim.
cards.uzDef: O'ziga notanish va noqulay muhitda bo'lish.

cards.ex: You need to get a grip and stop panicking.
cards.exUz: O'zingni bosib, vahima qilishni to'xtatishing kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'z his-tuyg'ularini nazorat qilish, xotirjam bo'lish.

cards.ex: She always goes the extra mile to help her colleagues.
cards.exUz: U hamkasblariga yordam berish uchun har doim ko'proq harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Odatdagidan ko'proq harakat qilish, g'ayrat ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: Hang in there; things will get better soon.
cards.exUz: Chida; tez orada vaziyat yaxshilanadi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda taslim bo'lmaslik, bardosh berish.

cards.ex: I have a sweet tooth, so I always crave dessert.
cards.exUz: Menda shirinlikka mehr bor, shuning uchun har doim desert yegim keladi.
cards.uzDef: Shirinliklarni juda yaxshi ko'rish.

cards.ex: He's in deep water with the IRS because he didn't pay his taxes.
cards.exUz: U soliq to'lamagani uchun Soliq xizmati bilan jiddiy muammoga duch keldi.
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy muammolarga duch kelgan, qiyin vaziyatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: They jumped the gun and announced the product before it was ready.
cards.exUz: Ular mahsulot tayyor bo'lmasdan oldin uni e'lon qilib, shoshilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqti kelmasdan oldin nimadir qilish, shoshilish.

cards.ex: I keep him at arm's length because I don't trust him.
cards.exUz: Men unga ishonmaganim uchun uni chetda saqlayman.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir yoki nimanidir o'zidan uzoqda saqlash, yaqinlashtirmaslik.

cards.ex: It takes time to learn the ropes in a new job.
cards.exUz: Yangi ishda ishni o'rganish uchun vaqt kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi ish yoki faoliyatni qanday bajarishni o'rganish.

cards.ex: To make a long story short, we won the game.
cards.exUz: Qisqasi, biz o'yinda g'alaba qozondik.
cards.uzDef: Hikoyani qisqartirib aytganda, asosiy nuqtaga o'tish.

cards.ex: It's tough, but no pain, no gain.
cards.exUz: Bu qiyin, lekin mehnat qilsang, rohat ko'rasan.
cards.uzDef: Muammosiz natijaga erishib bo'lmaydi, harakat qilish kerak.

cards.ex: We need to make sure we're all on the same page before we start the project.
cards.exUz: Loyiha boshlashdan oldin, hammamiz bir xil fikrda ekanligimizga ishonch hosil qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil fikrda bo'lish, kelishib olish.

cards.ex: The surgery was successful, but she's not out of the woods yet.
cards.exUz: Operatsiya muvaffaqiyatli o'tdi, lekin u hali xavfdan chiqqani yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli yoki qiyin vaziyatdan chiqqan, muammoni yenggan.

cards.ex: Teachers should practice what they preach and be good role models.
cards.exUz: O'qituvchilar o'zlari gapirgan narsaga amal qilishlari va yaxshi namuna bo'lishlari kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'zing gapirgan narsaga amal qilmoq, namuna bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: I didn't want to rock the boat, so I didn't voice my opinion.
cards.exUz: Men vaziyatni buzishni xohlamadim, shuning uchun o'z fikrimni bildirmadim.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni yoki muhitni buzadigan harakatlar qilish.

cards.ex: Speak of the devil! Here's John now.
cards.exUz: Eshak keldi! Mana, Jon ham keldi.
cards.uzDef: Biz gaplashayotgan odam kelib qoldi.
